how_it_works: Two single-mode waveguides run apart at the four ports, are brought together by S-bend access sections to a small edge-to-edge gap, run near-parallel over a short coupling region where their evanescent fields overlap, then S-bend back apart. Power transfers between the two guides at a rate set by the supermode beat length; the fraction transferred is governed by the gap (sets coupling strength kappa) and the coupling length (sets accumulated phase kappa*L).
topology_reasoning: From dense pixel profiling: waveguide thickness ~0.65um constant along both arms. Top-arm centerline offset from device center is flat at 1.175um for x in [0,1.5] (straight lead), sweeps monotonically to 0.475um by x~8 (raised-cosine S-bend), stays flat at ~0.475um over x in [8,10] (coupling region, sep 0.95um => gap 0.30um), sweeps back to 1.175um, then flat lead again. Bottom arm is the mirror image. Symmetric about x=9 and about the horizontal midline => a balanced directional coupler, not an MZI (no arm-length imbalance, no ring).
function_knobs: wg_width  - single-mode guide width (kappa, phase velocity)
coupling_gap - edge-to-edge gap in the coupling region (sets kappa; the dominant coupler knob)
coupling_length - straight parallel length over which power transfers (sets total kappa*L / split ratio)
bend_length - S-bend access length (adiabaticity / parasitic coupling in the bends)
port_separation - center-to-center guide separation at the ports

iterations.change_made: initial build: port_sep=2.35, gap=0.30, coupling_length=2.0, bend=6.5, straight=1.5; raised-cosine S-bends + straight coupling flat
port_sep 2.35->2.18, gap 0.30->0.26 (arms in) -- overshot: ports+coupling now too far inward
port_sep 2.18->2.30, gap 0.26->0.32 (split the difference); remaining error = S-bend descends too slowly (red-outer/blue-inner through bends)
steeper bend: bend_length 6.5->5.5, coupling_length 2.0->4.0 -- matched measured descent; but coupling flat now too long
start bend earlier + shorten flat: straight 1.5->1.0, bend 5.5->6.5, coupling 4.0->3.0 -- bend curvature + flat length both fit
final: port_sep 2.30->2.34, gap 0.32->0.37 -- lift ports and coupling flat to target separations; precision 0.991, recall 0.974

knob_response.note: coupling_length lengthens BOTH coupled arms, so layer-(1,0) area grows by 2*wg_width*delta = 2*0.65*2.0 = 2.6 um^2 (checked with width_um=2*wg_width=1.30). area_ok=True proves the knob moves real geometry. delta_length_ok=False is EXPECTED: this is a balanced coupler (two equal arms, delta_length identically 0 by symmetry); the delta_length sub-check is the MZI-imbalance contract and does not apply to a symmetric directional coupler.
